column3: Know the business you invest in. BlockID Business Passport gives every shareholder, large or small, a live view of the business they own: updates and valuations analysed by AI and approved by people, a share register on blockchain as proof of ownership, and dividends paid straight to their wallet.
It works today on testnet. Open the site: no sign-up, no wallet. You land in a demo investor account, with sample data.

Why does this matter? Investing in a business is hard to follow. The numbers are hard to trust. After you invest, you lose sight of sales, profit and new shares. Ownership sits in a spreadsheet, so your stake can shrink and nobody tells you. And dividends are slow, or never arrive. Good businesses struggle to raise money, and problems surface too late to fix.
So we built one passport per business. Every investor can understand it, follow it, own it, get paid, and check it for themselves.

Understand it. Paste a website and get a plain report in minutes: a business score from A to E, and a low, mid and high value. Every figure links to its source. No source, no number. And a person approves it before anyone sees it.
Behind the report, AI agents read the website, find competitors and analyse the market. A finding that cites a page the agent never fetched is dropped. The agents hold no keys. They can only propose.
Own it. Every holder, wallet and share count sits in one share register on blockchain, copied to Ethereum and HashKey Chain. New shares need a person's approval, and investors see the dilution first.
This is a sample listing for Airwallex, built from public information, on our test network. Fifteen holders, read straight from the chain, not from a spreadsheet.

Follow it, and get paid. The business shares its numbers, weekly, monthly, quarterly or yearly. The draft flags risks from the numbers, a person approves it, and every investor gets the same update at the same time. A dividend rule is approved once. After twenty-four hours to cancel, it is paid to every wallet, with no fees for holders.
Check it. Don't trust us. Your browser hashes the report and compares it with the record on three blockchains. Change one number, and it turns red.

Under the hood, only approved actions reach the chain. AI analysis runs with no keys. An admin wallet signs one approval. Only then does the isolated issuer, the only part with a key, act. Our AgentProvenance contract records who proposed and who approved. Agents propose. Humans approve. Chains prove.

The whole flow works on testnet today, with fourteen sample listings built from public information. We have no real users yet. Next: our first pilot businesses, investor communities and licensed partners. Businesses will pay a listing fee, a register subscription, and small transfer and dividend fees. Try it at eth dot blockid dot au.
